Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Class MailSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailSettings
public final class MailSettings extends Object
The user-customizable appearance and behaviour of the mail client, persisted under the /mail/settings Preferences node.

load() reads the stored values (falling back to sensible defaults on first run); mutating the setters and calling save() writes them back. The 2D MailPanel re-reads these live after the settings dialog closes so a change (theme, fonts, density, reading-pane position, sort, auto-check, HTML rendering) takes effect immediately.
